lines.zh: 我横着爬过湿沙，八条腿咔咔响。
lines.en: I scuttle sideways, eight legs clicking on wet sand.

lines.zh: 钳子举在前头，我一步一探。
lines.en: Claws raised ahead of me, I test every step.

lines.zh: 沙粒在我壳下沙沙地滑开。
lines.en: Grains of sand hiss away beneath my shell.

lines.zh: 退潮的滩涂上，我走得很快。
lines.en: On the ebb flats I move quickly.

lines.zh: 我从红树根缝里钻出来，横着走。
lines.en: I slip out between mangrove roots and walk sideways.

lines.zh: 小壳贴着水底，我溜进海草里。
lines.en: Shell low to the bottom, I slide into the seagrass.

lines.zh: 我踩过贝壳，发出细碎的响声。
lines.en: Stepping over shells, I make a faint crackling sound.

lines.zh: 水只到我的壳顶，我照样横行。
lines.en: Water barely covers my shell, yet I still walk sideways.

lines.zh: 我绕着水洼转圈，找下一个缝。
lines.en: I circle the pool looking for the next gap.

lines.zh: 脚下的沙一软，我半只陷进去。
lines.en: The sand softens and half of me sinks in.

lines.zh: 我贴着滩边移动，眼睛不离水面。
lines.en: I hug the shoreline, eyes fixed on the water.

lines.zh: 我爬过红草地，壳上沾了草屑。
lines.en: I cross the red meadow with grass stuck to my shell.

lines.zh: 钳子敲了一下石头，我改道走。
lines.en: One tap of claw on stone and I change direction.

lines.zh: 我一路横行，把沙面划出细线。
lines.en: Walking sideways, I scratch thin lines in the sand.

lines.zh: 两只钳子倒着举，我先探路
lines.en: Both claws raised backward, I scout ahead.

lines.zh: 浅水里我贴着沙，壳只露一点
lines.en: In the shallows I hug the sand, shell barely showing.

lines.zh: 海草擦过我的腿，我偏了偏
lines.en: Seagrass brushes my legs; I lean aside.

lines.zh: 我要去那块石头下面
lines.en: I am heading under that stone.

lines.zh: 我把半个身子埋进沙里，只露眼睛。
lines.en: I bury half of myself and show only my eyes.

lines.zh: 我举着钳子，等一只倒霉的螺。
lines.en: Claws up, I wait for some unlucky snail.

lines.zh: 泡泡从我的口边一串串冒上去。
lines.en: Bubbles rise in strings from beside my mouth.

lines.zh: 我用钳子梳自己的壳，慢慢来。
lines.en: I comb my shell with a claw, taking my time.

lines.zh: 海草影子晃，我盯着看了很久。
lines.en: Seagrass shadows sway and I stare for a long while.

lines.zh: 潮水退了一格，我懒得挪窝。
lines.en: The tide drops a notch and I cannot be bothered to move.

lines.zh: 我蹲在红树根下，听水拍木头。
lines.en: Under the mangrove roots I listen to water tapping wood.

lines.zh: 一只小螺爬过，我抬钳又放下。
lines.en: A small snail passes; I raise a claw and lower it.

lines.zh: 我把沙刨开又盖上，像在藏东西。
lines.en: I dig the sand up and cover it again, as if hiding something.

lines.zh: 我壳上的花斑在浅水里发亮。
lines.en: The flowered spots on my shell glow in the shallows.

lines.zh: 我盯着远处海龟的影子发呆。
lines.en: I stare blankly at a turtle shadow in the distance.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳缝，只留钳尖在外面。
lines.en: I tuck into a crevice with only my claw tips out.

lines.zh: 水流过我的鳃，我慢慢吐气。
lines.en: Water passes my gills and I breathe out slowly.

lines.zh: 我数着气泡，数到一半就忘了。
lines.en: I count bubbles and forget the number halfway.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只钳子，冲你晃了晃。
lines.en: I lift one claw and wave it at you.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩进我的沙，我盯着它。
lines.en: Your boots sink into my sand and I stare at them.

lines.zh: 我从草叶后面探出眼睛看你。
lines.en: I peek at you from behind a blade of grass.

lines.zh: 我横着挪开半步，钳子还举着。
lines.en: I sidestep half a pace, claws still raised.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我立刻压低身子。
lines.en: You crouch and I flatten myself at once.

lines.zh: 我歪着壳，像在估量你的脚趾。
lines.en: I tilt my shell, sizing up your toes.

lines.zh: 你一走近，我的腿就绷紧了。
lines.en: As you come closer my legs go tense.

lines.zh: 我把钳子张到最大，让你看清。
lines.en: I open both claws wide so you can see them.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我，我停了动作。
lines.en: Your shadow covers me and I freeze.

lines.zh: 我退到水边，眼睛没离开你。
lines.en: I back to the waterline without taking my eyes off you.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一道，我疼得直转圈。
lines.en: My shell has cracked and I spin in pain.

lines.zh: 被砸中背甲，我的腿全缩了。
lines.en: Hit on the back plate, all my legs curl in.

lines.zh: 我掉了一只钳尖，还在流血。
lines.en: I lost a claw tip and I am still bleeding.

lines.zh: 这一下让我翻过去，爬不起来。
lines.en: The blow flips me over and I cannot get up.

lines.zh: 我太小了，挨一下就晕。
lines.en: I am so small that one hit dazes me.

lines.zh: 背上火辣辣的，我往沙里钻。
lines.en: My back burns and I dig into the sand.

lines.zh: 钳子抖得夹不住任何东西。
lines.en: My claws shake too much to grip anything.

lines.zh: 我横着逃，沙被血染了颜色。
lines.en: I flee sideways and the sand turns red behind me.

lines.zh: 疼，我先躲进海草再说。
lines.en: It hurts; I will hide in the seagrass first.

lines.zh: 壳里有水声，我知道自己伤了。
lines.en: Water sloshes in my shell and I know I am hurt.

lines.zh: 鱼腥味飘来，我的钳子先动了。
lines.en: Fish scent drifts over and my claws move first.

lines.zh: 你手里的碎肉在滴水，我跟着走。
lines.en: Scraps in your hand drip, and I follow them.

lines.zh: 我闻到了血味，横着追了两步。
lines.en: I smell blood and scuttle two steps after it.

lines.zh: 那块鱼皮一晃，我就忘了害怕。
lines.en: A scrap of fish skin swings and I forget to be afraid.

lines.zh: 我举钳去够你指间晃的东西。
lines.en: I reach a claw for what dangles between your fingers.

lines.zh: 潮水带来味道，我顺着它爬。
lines.en: The tide brings a smell and I crawl along it.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我横着跟一步。
lines.en: You step back once and I sidestep once.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的脚找掉下来的碎屑。
lines.en: I circle your feet hunting fallen crumbs.

lines.zh: 食物在沙上晃，我顾不上壳小。
lines.en: Food wobbles on the sand, and I stop caring how small I am.

lines.zh: 我钳住那点气味，越爬越靠前。
lines.en: I pinch at that smell and crawl closer and closer.

lines.zh: 被撞得一歪，我举起两只钳子。
lines.en: Knocked askew, I raise both claws.

lines.zh: 你踢到我，我翻了个身又爬起。
lines.en: You kick me; I roll over and scramble up again.

lines.zh: 壳碰壳，我立刻夹回去一下。
lines.en: Shell against shell, I pinch back immediately.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的鞋，钳子夹了个空。
lines.en: I bump your shoe and my claws close on nothing.

lines.zh: 挤过来一只海龟，我被顶开。
lines.en: A turtle shoves past and I am pushed aside.

lines.zh: 沙被我蹬起来，我撞回了原处。
lines.en: Sand sprays as I am shoved back where I started.

lines.zh: 谁踩了我的背，我横着逃开。
lines.en: Someone steps on my back and I scuttle away.

lines.zh: 我夹住裤脚，随即松开就跑。
lines.en: I grip a trouser hem, then let go and run.

lines.zh: 水流把我推得一晃，我稳住腿。
lines.en: The current shoves me; I steady my legs.

lines.zh: 我被挤进石缝，钳子还在乱挥。
lines.en: Squeezed into a crack, I still swing my claws wildly.

lines.zh: 我举起钳子上下摇，等回应。
lines.en: I raise my claws and shake them, waiting for an answer.

lines.zh: 我在沙上敲出节拍，喊同伴来。
lines.en: I drum a rhythm on the sand to call a mate over.

lines.zh: 她横着过来，我的钳子放低了。
lines.en: She comes sideways, and I lower my claws.

lines.zh: 两只花蟹并排走，壳几乎贴着。
lines.en: Two flower crabs walk abreast, shells almost touching.

lines.zh: 我刨了一个浅坑，让她先钻。
lines.en: I scrape a shallow pit and let her enter first.

lines.zh: 我护在她外侧，钳子朝外张。
lines.en: I guard her outer side with my claws spread out.

lines.zh: 我们用钳子碰了一下，算说好了。
lines.en: We tap claws once, and that settles it.

lines.zh: 潮水涨起来，我们一起往里走。
lines.en: The tide rises and we walk in together.

lines.zh: 她嫌我靠太近，我退回半寸。
lines.en: She thinks I am too close, so I back off an inch.

lines.zh: 我把最好的一块沙地让给她。
lines.en: I give her the best patch of sand.

lines.zh: 我试着夹起贝壳，掉了三次。
lines.en: I try to pick up a shell and drop it three times.

lines.zh: 小钳子夹不住，我用嘴顶。
lines.en: My small claws cannot hold it, so I push with my mouth.

lines.zh: 我拖着一块鱼骨，走得很慢。
lines.en: I drag a fish bone and move very slowly.

lines.zh: 这东西太重，我的钳子在打滑。
lines.en: It is too heavy and my claws keep slipping.

lines.zh: 我把它压在身下，慢慢往回搬。
lines.en: I pin it under myself and haul it back little by little.

lines.zh: 我用两条后腿推，沙全堆上来。
lines.en: I push with my hind legs and sand piles up in front.

lines.zh: 壳太小，装不下，我只好放下。
lines.en: My shell is too small to hold it, so I let it go.

lines.zh: 我夹着水草，草尖一路拖地。
lines.en: I carry seagrass with the tips dragging behind me.

lines.zh: 有东西闪了一下，我钳起来看。
lines.en: Something glints and I pinch it up to look.

lines.zh: 我抱着那颗卵石，钳子发抖。
lines.en: I hug a pebble and my claws tremble.

lines.zh: 一只小海龟爬过，我停了脚步。
lines.en: A small turtle crawls by and I stop walking.

lines.zh: 我看见了鳍，钳子自己张开。
lines.en: I see a flipper and my claws open by themselves.

lines.zh: 海龟比我大，可我还是跟上去。
lines.en: The turtle is bigger than me, but I still follow.

lines.zh: 它的脚在沙上划，我锁定了。
lines.en: Its feet rake the sand and I lock on.

lines.zh: 我转了个方向，朝那只海龟去。
lines.en: I turn and head for that turtle.

lines.zh: 沙里冒出一只小龟，我盯住了。
lines.en: A hatchling pops out of the sand and I fix on it.

lines.zh: 我嗅到新壳的味道，开始靠近。
lines.en: I smell a fresh shell and start closing in.

lines.zh: 海龟慢，我不急，横着绕过去。
lines.en: The turtle is slow, so I circle sideways without hurrying.

lines.zh: 我举起钳子，标记了这个目标。
lines.en: I raise my claws and mark this target.

lines.zh: 它一停，我就知道机会来了。
lines.en: It stops, and I know my chance has come.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面靠近，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I approach along the sand, as silent as I can.

lines.zh: 钳子举高，我一步步横着逼过去。
lines.en: Claws high, I press forward one sideways step at a time.

lines.zh: 我绕到它后面，等鳍再动一次。
lines.en: I circle behind it and wait for the flipper to move again.

lines.zh: 它抬头，我就停住，装成石头。
lines.en: It lifts its head, so I freeze and play stone.

lines.zh: 我离它只有一钳长，忍住不动。
lines.en: One claw-length away, I hold myself still.

lines.zh: 海龟划水的节奏，我全记下了。
lines.en: I have memorized the rhythm of its paddling.

lines.zh: 我夹了一下水，试它的反应。
lines.en: I pinch the water to test its reaction.

lines.zh: 它往深处爬，我跟着换个角度。
lines.en: It climbs deeper and I shift my angle to follow.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，腿在沙里绷紧。
lines.en: I lower myself, legs braced in the sand.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我的钳子就够到了。
lines.en: A little closer and my claws will reach.

lines.zh: 我夹住它的鳍边，用力拧。
lines.en: I clamp onto its flipper edge and twist hard.

lines.zh: 钳子合上的一下，沙都溅起来。
lines.en: When my claws snap shut, sand sprays up.

lines.zh: 我咬了它的脚蹼，立刻退开。
lines.en: I bite its webbed foot and retreat at once.

lines.zh: 它甩我，我夹得更紧不放。
lines.en: It shakes me off; I pinch tighter and hold on.

lines.zh: 我横着一撞，把它顶得偏了。
lines.en: I ram it sideways and knock it off course.

lines.zh: 两只钳子轮流上，我打得很急。
lines.en: Both claws strike in turn, fast and frantic.

lines.zh: 我夹到壳缝，它疼得往前冲。
lines.en: I catch a seam in its shell and it lunges in pain.

lines.zh: 一下没夹稳，我翻倒在沙上。
lines.en: One pinch misses and I tumble onto the sand.

lines.zh: 它拍水，我被冲开又扑回去。
lines.en: It slaps the water, and I am washed off and lunge back.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，直到它转身逃。
lines.en: I hold on until it turns and flees.

lines.zh: 红树根下的沙一松，我钻出来。
lines.en: The sand under the mangrove roots loosens and I emerge.

lines.zh: 我从海草床的泥里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of the mud of the seagrass bed.

lines.zh: 这片红草地是我的新地方。
lines.en: This red meadow is my new home ground.

lines.zh: 潮刚退，我就在浅水里现身。
lines.en: The tide has just fallen and I appear in the shallows.

lines.zh: 我和另一只一起从沙里冒头。
lines.en: Another crab and I surface from the sand together.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水温刚好，我伸开腿。
lines.en: The swamp water suits me and I stretch my legs.

lines.zh: 我顶开一层沙，看见了天光。
lines.en: I push off a layer of sand and see daylight.

lines.zh: 新滩涂没人来过，我先横一圈。
lines.en: No one has been on this flat, so I take a first sideways lap.

lines.zh: 壳还软，我小心地爬向水边。
lines.en: My shell is still soft, so I crawl carefully to the water.

lines.zh: 我从上游漂下来，落在这片沙。
lines.en: I drift down from upstream and land on this sand.

lines.zh: 壳被烤得发红，我拼命往水里爬。
lines.en: My shell glows red and I scramble desperately for water.

lines.zh: 从石头上摔下，我的壳磕在沙里。
lines.en: Dropped from a rock, my shell slams into the sand.

lines.zh: 水淹过头顶，我的鳃吸不到气。
lines.en: Water covers my head and my gills get no air.

lines.zh: 轰一声，我被气浪甩到远处。
lines.en: With a boom, the blast throws me far away.

lines.zh: 箭钉进壳缝，我疼得直打转。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my shell seam and I spin in agony.

lines.zh: 一股怪力钻进壳里，我的腿麻了。
lines.en: Strange force seeps into my shell and my legs go numb.

lines.zh: 饿了太久，我的钳子举不起来。
lines.en: I have gone hungry so long I cannot lift my claws.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的壳烧焦一片。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and a patch of my shell is scorched.

lines.zh: 四周全黑了，我的腿踩不到沙。
lines.en: Everything is black and my legs find no sand.
